title: Electrician Apprenticeship
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Electrician Apprenticeship - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Apply a working knowledge of math formulas and complex solution methods related to the electrical trades, along with blueprint symbols and drawings of wiring diagrams with common schematic symbols, including troubleshooting of common system faults, detection and repair, while properly applying OSHA construction site safety standards to all practices.

Properly apply all pertinent National Electric Code (NEC) to all workplace practices involving DC, AC single and poly-phase systems, utilizing proper grounding, bonding, lightning protection, wire sizing, conduit fill, overload protection, layout, connections, installations, troubleshooting, fault isolation, repairs or modifications.

Demonstrate appropriate leadership and expertise in applying special control and monitoring functions related to layout, installation, testing, and troubleshooting of digital and analog systems involving such ancillary equipment as CATV, CCTV, telephone circuits, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), sensors, actuators, low-voltage and high-voltage, transformation, interfacing, hardware, setup, and programming services needed to comply with all NFPA-70E (NEC) and OSHA regulations for safety and fitness.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement; the single requirements list (35.00 units) and the single Program Learning Outcomes list are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the certificate.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (ELE-400 etc.); these match the closed-list codes (ELE 400 etc.), so none are marked as catalog additions.

The introductory text mentions an 'Associate in Arts Degree' while the heading names an Associate of Science Degree; this inconsistency does not affect the certificate requirements but a reviewer may wish to check it.
The heading includes program codes NAS485/C/NCE485.
